comment: The weather of the first dungeon: dust motes that fall and settle (D-187, D-202, D-893). Each mote falls 24 art pixels over 3 seconds, and the sway pulls it 3 pixels to each side on the way, as a sheet of paper falls. It then lies on the ground for 5 seconds, and it goes out. A mote takes the strength of each light and never its color, so it reads as light gray inside a pool of torchlight and as dark gray outside one (D-183, D-893). Each count is the motes of one cell of 640 by 360 art pixels (D-842). PR-17 gives the first places their own weather (D-520).
